newsitem.title: USA: Terex sets public offering at $19.50/shr.
newsitem.headline: Terex sets public offering at $19.50/shr.

text.p: Terex Corp said Wednesday that it has set a public offering of seven million shares of common stock at $19.50 per share.
Of the total number of shares, five million are being sold by the company and two million are being sold by a selling stockholder, it said.
In addition, Terex has granted the underwriters an option to purchase up to an additional 700,000 shares to cover any over-allotments.
The proceeds are to be used to repay outstanding debt, including the redemption of a portion of its 13-1/4 percent Senior Secured Notes due 2002, and for general corporate purposes.
Terex is a diversified global manufacturer of a broad range of heavy equipment, including trucks and cranes.
